writeup: TIC 318907244 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star that completes its orbit every 1.0233 days. When the primary star passes in front of its companion, the system dims by 1.95 percent - a signal detected with high confidence by automated search methods. Astronomers have not yet observed a secondary eclipse, which would occur when the companion star crosses in front of the primary. This candidate passed all data quality checks and does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs, making it a genuine discovery. The detection represents the kind of new binary system that patient automated surveys can uncover, adding to our catalog of these stellar pairs.
